name: One hub, three product benefits
description: Explain a SaaS or service bundle without presenting a full unreadable dashboard. Builds an editable 15-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: One service connects several distinct benefits around a clear central idea.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 15 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Your product icon sits in the center. The problem it solves shows next to it.

props.text: Your product icon, ideally on a transparent background.

props.label: Problem
props.placeholder: Too many tools for one job
props.hint: Plain words. The viewer knows the problem at once.

props.subtitle: Each card connects to the hub, one at a time. Give each card an image and one line.
All three cards stay on screen with the outcome and the call to action.

props.label: Outcome and call to action
props.placeholder: Everything in one place. Try it free

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

elements.direction: First dims to 0.45 opacity; second enters in 250 ms.

elements.direction: Third connects, then group scales back 8% to show the system.

shots.title: Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.

elements.direction: 180 ms fade for outcome; no further card movement.

value.title: One hub, three product benefits
value.objective: Explain a SaaS or service bundle without presenting a full unreadable dashboard.
value.direction: A single hub remains stable while one benefit card at a time receives attention.
beats: 0–2 s: Hub and plain-language problem are already visible. Shows Brand color, Hub icon, Problem.
2–5 s: First card connects to the hub. Shows Brand color, Hub icon, Benefit card 1, Benefit 1.
5–8 s: Second card replaces the first as focal point. Shows Brand color, Hub icon, Benefit card 2, Benefit 2.
8–11.5 s: Third card enters; the completed hub becomes visible. Shows Brand color, Hub icon, Benefit card 3, Benefit 3.
11.5–15 s: Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together. Shows Brand color, Hub icon, Benefit card 1, Benefit card 2, Benefit card 3, Logo, Outcome and call to action.

images.label: Hub icon
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: Hub and plain-language problem are already visible. | First card connects to the hub. | Second card replaces the first as focal point. | Third card enters; the completed hub becomes visible. | Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.

images.label: Benefit card 1
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: First card connects to the hub. | Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.

images.label: Benefit card 2
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Second card replaces the first as focal point. | Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.

images.label: Benefit card 3
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Third card enters; the completed hub becomes visible. | Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Three-card system, outcome and CTA hold together.
